baseline_models.focus_anchor: The oath joins نَفْسٍ at 91:7[1] to سَوَّىٰهَا at 91:7[3], with the feminine object pronoun returning the configuring act to that same self.
baseline_models.mechanism: The living soul-self is not presented as a bare unit but together with the act or agent that gives it internal straightness and sound completion. The paired oath therefore foregrounds both an achieved living whole and the formative relation that makes it coherent.

activation_trace.role: The living soul-self supplies the animate whole whose constitution is being considered.
Internal straightness and sound completion supply the formative operation that integrates the living whole.

changed_reading.before: A soul, and whoever or whatever made it.
changed_reading.after: A living whole, together with the act or agent that brought its own constitution into internally sound completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَفْسٍ can name the inward mind and hidden intent, while سَوَّىٰهَا can activate equivalence and a fair middle.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can describe calibration within an interior field: thought, intention, and discernment are placed into measured relation rather than left as an undifferentiated substance. This is structural equilibrium, not yet a verdict that every impulse is morally equal.

activation_trace.role: The inner mind, thought, and hidden intent make the oath's object an inward field of discernment.
Equality and equivalence supply measured relation among distinguishable inward powers.
The middle, fairness, and even meeting place make equilibrium a relational center rather than featureless sameness.

changed_reading.before: The self was given a generally well-proportioned form.
changed_reading.after: The self's hidden cognitive and intentional powers were calibrated into a workable internal relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventory places birth within ن ف س and full maturity within س و ي, allowing سَوَّىٰهَا to span a developmental arc.
baseline_models.mechanism: The shaping can be read temporally: emergent life is carried toward mature bodily, intellectual, and dispositional capacity. Completion is then a process of becoming able, not merely an instantaneous geometric arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Birth and postpartum emergence provide the developmental starting edge of the self.
The living soul-self carries continuity between emergence and later capacity.
Reaching full bodily and intellectual maturity supplies the developmental endpoint of taswiya.

changed_reading.before: The self was fashioned as a finished object.
changed_reading.after: Living emergence was brought toward mature strength, form, and intelligence through a completing process.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The inward-intent branch of ن ف س meets two directional branches of س و ي in the causative focus verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: Taswiya may include orienting rather than only balancing: an inwardly intending self is furnished with the capacity to turn toward and aim at a direction. The focus then concerns a directional agent, while leaving the direction and its later use open.

activation_trace.role: Hidden intent supplies the interior source from which direction can arise.
Turning toward a direction supplies an orienting function for the formative act.
Aiming toward a person or direction sharpens orientation into targetable intention.

changed_reading.before: The self was made proportionate.
changed_reading.after: The self was fitted with inward intention and the capacity to orient and aim, without predetermining its chosen target.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Several ن ف س branches image breath, relief through space, and opening or spreading; سَوَّىٰهَا anchors those motions in sound regulation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The self can be carried as an open living process whose integrity depends on patterned exchange: breath exits, constriction is relieved by room, and openings spread without destroying the whole. Taswiya becomes dynamic regulation of expansion and return rather than immobile symmetry.

activation_trace.role: Breath leaving the body supplies rhythmic exchange as a literal image of living selfhood.
Relief by giving breath and space makes room an enabling condition for continued life.
Opening and spreading like breath supply expansion that can remain part of a regulated whole.
Sound internal completion contains the respiratory imagery within an organized living system.

changed_reading.before: The self is a bounded entity made even.
changed_reading.after: The self is an open, breathing process made sound through regulated expansion, exchange, and relief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered light sequence changes interior equilibrium from a static midpoint into serial regulation. Illumination emerges, a second light follows, day opens and reveals, then night covers; an inward self can accordingly remain coherent across alternating states of disclosure and concealment.

activation_trace.role: The hidden mind and intent provide the focus-ayah interior in which disclosure and concealment can alternate.
Equivalence supplies the balancing relation that the context turns from static symmetry into a sequence.
The sun and its brightness supply the primary pole of overt illumination.
Emergence into sunlight and visibility make illumination an event of coming forth.
The moon and its light supply a distinct succeeding mode of illumination.
Following and succession turn the two lights into an ordered transition rather than a loose pair.
Day opening through light supplies an expansive phase in the regulatory cycle.
Uncovering and appearance supply the cycle's disclosure function.
Night and its darkness supply the contrasting phase rather than a defect in the cycle.
A covering that rises over and conceals supplies controlled occlusion as the reverse operation of disclosure.

structural_cues: 91:1-4 form an ordered series of light, following, opening, revealing, darkness, and covering.
Repeated feminine hā endings formally anticipate the focus clause's return to the feminine نَفْس, without requiring a shared referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered illumination, succession, disclosure, and covering; I supply the arrow from that sequence to cyclical regulation within the focus self. A live alternative is that the series remains only a cosmic oath pattern and does not specify inner dynamics.

changed_reading.before: Taswiya gives the inward self a stable equilibrium.
changed_reading.after: Taswiya gives the inward self coherence across recurring phases of emergence, disclosure, concealment, and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky-building and earth-spreading pair activates the self as a composite habitat. Height, joined construction, supporting members, a lower field, and extension together make taswiya the production of an internally inhabitable space with differentiated regions and room for movement.

activation_trace.role: The very thing itself anchors the architectural analogy in the self's whole identity rather than in an external building.
Leeway, distance, and spaciousness give the self an extensible interior rather than point-like identity.
Wide smooth ground supplies a focus-internal spatial image onto which the earth sequence can latch.
What is high and overshadows supplies an upper enclosure for the habitat analogy.
Building by joining parts supplies composition as the causal mechanism of internal order.
A composite structure supplies differentiated organization rather than homogeneous mass.
Ribs or supports on which something rests supply load-bearing relations among the self's parts.
The lower counterpart to the sky supplies the habitat's grounding field.
Spreading and extending supply the production of room in which an organized self can act.

structural_cues: 91:5-7 repeats the pattern of a noun followed by wa-mā and a causative shaping verb with feminine hā.
The self follows the upper-built and lower-spread pair, inviting scale transfer without making the self identical to the cosmos.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies upper enclosure, construction by joined parts, supports, lower ground, and extension; I infer that their formal parallel models the self as a small-scale habitat. The live alternative is a rhetorical parallel of created things with no transfer of architecture into النفس.

changed_reading.before: The self is a single object whose outline was made proportionate.
changed_reading.after: The self is a composed, load-bearing, internally spacious habitat whose differentiated regions were fitted into one whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel turns inward proportion into a threshold system. The self receives or internalizes opposed possibilities; one is imaged as fissure, sudden opening, and breach of a cover, while the other is damage-preventing protection. Taswiya therefore equips a bounded but permeable self to register both breach and safeguarding, not to endorse them equally.

activation_trace.role: The inner mind and hidden intent provide the receiving and discerning interior.
Opening and spreading supply an aperture whose regulation can succeed or fail.
Internal straightness and completion supply the intact condition against which breach and protection become legible.
Swallowing and taking something in fully supply a material image for inward reception or assimilation.
A broad fissure and bursting forth supply the literal mechanics of a threshold opening.
Deviation from right and rupture of a covering turn the opening into a morally charged breach.
Warding off harm by protection supplies the opposed boundary-preserving operation.
Placing oneself within protection makes safeguarding a self-involving response rather than an external wall alone.

structural_cues: The hā pronouns in 91:8 repeatedly return both named possibilities to the self introduced in 91:7.
The paired nouns فجورها وتقواها present opposed operations inside one grammatical possession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward intake, fissure or veil-breach, and protective enclosure; I supply the arrow to a regulated moral threshold within the focus self. A live alternative is that these are ethical labels with no material permeability model, and the swallowing branch is especially form-distant.

changed_reading.before: The self was balanced between equivalent inner components.
changed_reading.after: The self was made as an intact yet permeable threshold-system able to recognize both boundary-breaking release and self-protective restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier fertile earth and spreading images combine with the later ploughman, success, growth, and purification branches. The self's taswiya becomes preparation of an arable field: initial formation supplies workable ground, while later cultivation can split, aerate, clean, and increase what grows there.

activation_trace.role: The living soul-self keeps the terrain analogy anchored in a living subject capable of growth.
Wide smooth open ground supplies the focus-side image of a field prepared for use.
Sound completion makes preparation a viable starting condition, not the crop's final moral state.
Soft fertile earth supplies the material substrate capable of receiving cultivation.
Spreading and extending supply the preparation of an available field.
The ploughman who cuts the earth supplies active cultivation rather than passive possession of good soil.
Success and enduring survival supply the functional yield of cultivation.
Growth and increase supply the crop-like result of working the self.
Purity and soundness add clearing and repair to the growth mechanism.

structural_cues: The earth is spread in 91:6, the self is proportioned in 91:7, and that self is acted upon with زكّى in 91:9.
The same feminine hā chain makes the prepared field analogy especially available while retaining distinct literal referents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile spread ground, ploughing, success, growth, and purification; I infer a cultivation sequence whose substrate is the focus self. The live alternative is that the agricultural branches merely explain lexical history and that taswiya itself denotes completed form, not preparatory arability.

changed_reading.before: Taswiya finishes the self in a morally complete state.
changed_reading.after: Taswiya prepares a living and workable field whose later growth and purification still depend on cultivation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revelation and polishing oppose covering and hidden insertion, while purification names repair. These operations activate a layered self with surface and depth: taswiya establishes an inner structure that can be made manifest and polished, or pushed under and corrupted without ceasing to be the self's own interior.

activation_trace.role: Hidden thought and intent supply the depth that can later be disclosed or buried.
Internal soundness supplies the latent order affected by polishing, covering, purification, or corruption.
Uncovering and appearance supply movement from depth into visibility.
Polishing and clarification supply an operation that improves how inner order appears.
A covering that conceals supplies reversible occlusion of what remains underneath.
Purity and repair supply restoration of the self's latent sound order.
Insertion into hiding supplies the downward action by which the self is buried beneath its presentation.
Misguidance and corruption make concealment deformative rather than merely protective.

structural_cues: The reveal-cover pair precedes the focus, while purifying versus burying the same feminine object follows it.
The repeated operations imply changes of accessibility and condition, not replacement of the self by another object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncovering, polishing, covering, purification, secret insertion, and corruption; I infer a surface-depth architecture in the focus self. A live alternative is that each verb carries an independent scene and no common visibility mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The self is simply present as a completed interior.
changed_reading.after: The self has depth and a presentational surface: its formed interior can be disclosed and polished or concealed and corrupted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The threshold reading acquires pressure and kinetics. Sudden abundant release, protection, water exceeding its bounds, and a dormant thing being stirred into motion model the self as a regulated reservoir of latent capacities. Transgression becomes an activated overflow across a limit, not a foreign substance inserted from outside.

activation_trace.role: Opening, swelling water, and waves throwing out water supply a focus-internal pressure and release image.
Internal straightness supplies the regulated condition from which overflow departs.
A large quantity rushing out suddenly supplies pressure release as a latent-to-actual transition.
Damage-preventing protection supplies containment and controlled response.
Exceeding a limit in disobedience names the failure of regulation in moral terms.
Water rising into overpowering overflow supplies the hydraulic mechanics of limit-exceeding.
Stirring what is still from dormancy supplies the activation of a previously latent capacity.
A group's forceful setting-out supplies the kinetic surge that follows activation.

structural_cues: 91:8 places opposed possibilities inside the self's pronominal domain; 91:11 names limit-exceeding; 91:12 immediately depicts activation and motion.
The sequence moves from latent possession to collective overflow and then to a mobilized individual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sudden release, protection, hydraulic overflow, and arousal from stillness; I infer a pressure-regulation system in the focus self. A live alternative is that the water image is only a lexical analogy for excess and that بعث marks narrative motion without describing psychic activation.

changed_reading.before: The self has a moral boundary that can be breached or protected.
changed_reading.after: The self is a reservoir of latent energies whose taswiya regulates activation and flow, while transgression is an overpowering overflow beyond that order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial, inner speech, signification, and sending activate the self as a representational routing system. Hidden intent can be formulated inwardly, encoded into outward signs or speech, and dispatched into action; the same interface can be spoofed by a lying self or deceptive covering.

activation_trace.role: Inner thought and hidden intent supply the message source within the focus self.
Turning toward a direction supplies routing from inward intent toward an outward target.
The lying self supplies the possibility that the internal source can falsify its own representation.
A garment deceptive in its appearance supplies a surface signal that can misrepresent what lies beneath.
Speech held within the self supplies pre-articulate internal formulation.
A thing's saying as its signification supplies the conversion of inner state into a legible sign.
Sending and setting forth supply transmission from the self toward another.
Messenger and message supply an explicit carrier-content relation for the routing model.

structural_cues: The narrative moves from communal denial through an individual's mobilization to a messenger's utterance.
The focus self's hidden intent is therefore followed by scenes in which inward stance becomes publicly consequential communication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lying self, deceptive appearance, inner speech, signification, and sending; I infer an encode-and-dispatch architecture furnished by the focus taswiya. A live alternative is that these are social acts external to the self rather than clues to its formed capacities.

changed_reading.before: The self was given intention and direction.
changed_reading.after: The self was fitted to formulate, signify, and dispatch intention into the world, with a built-in possibility of truthful transmission or representational spoofing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later naming of deity and lord, especially lordship joined to repair, nurture, and completion, sharpens the agentive side of وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا. The focus may swear by a purposive completing agency and not only by an impersonal pattern, while the source construction still permits the act of proportioning itself to remain foregrounded.

activation_trace.role: The living soul-self supplies the recipient of sustained formative agency.
Sound completion supplies the kind of formative work that can be attributed to a purposive agent.
Deity and worship supply an explicitly divine agentive horizon later in the sequence.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply agency capable of imposing order.
Repair, nurture, and bringing to completion closely match the focus act's completing branch.

structural_cues: The repeated wa-mā construction in 91:5-7 leaves agency grammatically open before explicit divine designations appear in 91:13-14.
رَبُّهُم stands immediately before the later recurrence of سَوَّىٰ in 91:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit deity and lordship plus a nurture-to-completion branch; I infer backward agentive sharpening of the focus mā. A live alternative is mā as a nominalized act or pattern, so this delta raises agentive salience without closing the construction.

changed_reading.before: The clause may foreground an unspecified process by which the self became proportionate.
changed_reading.after: The clause more strongly evokes purposive lordly formation and nurture, while still allowing the proportioning act itself to remain the oath's object.

context_deltas.mechanism: The she-camel and its watering activate two unusually concrete focus branches: a camel-back support under س و ي and breath-sized or life-sustaining drink under ن ف س. Taswiya can therefore be imaged as adaptive fitting of an embodied carrier whose movement and burden-bearing depend on support, management, and an apportioned channel of water.

activation_trace.role: A drinking breath or draught supplies paced intake by which an embodied self is sustained.
Life-sustaining water or drink makes hydration constitutive of continued living selfhood.
The camel-back pad or pack cloth supplies fitted support that distributes a carrier's load.
The she-camel and its bodily form provide the concrete living carrier that activates the focus support image.
Taming, training, and management supply functional fitting of living power to directed use.
Quenching a drinker supplies the sustaining input required by the carrier.
An allotted share of watering and its channel supply measured provision rather than undirected abundance.
The non-dominant mapped image of leg and the carrier it supports intensifies the load-bearing analogy while remaining form-distant.

structural_cues: 91:13 places the she-camel directly beside its protected watering share.
The focus inventories independently contain both a camel-back support and sustaining draughts, producing an unusually specific material resonance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a camel form, training, fitted pack support, paced drink, and allotted watering; I infer an analogy to the embodied self as a sustained carrier. A live alternative is that the animal scene has no anthropological transfer, especially for the non-dominant س و ق mapping.

changed_reading.before: Taswiya means abstract symmetry of an embodied self.
changed_reading.after: Taswiya can also image adaptive fitting: a water-dependent living carrier is given supports, capacities, and measured provision suited to movement and burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact سَوَّىٰ recurrence after hamstringing and annihilation reverses the emotional valence of the focus verb without erasing its constructive branch. Equalization and smooth ground can name either integration into sound form or reduction of differentiated life to a terminal level state. Taswiya is thus power to impose determinate order, not an intrinsically gentle synonym for improvement.

activation_trace.role: The self as the very whole thing supplies the differentiated identity affected by constructive completion.
Internal straightness and sound completion preserve the constructive reading at the focus.
Equality and equivalence supply the shared operation capable of taking either constructive or leveling valence.
Cutting a beast's legs supplies disabling loss of differentiated movement before the later leveling.
The root or base of a thing makes the destructive action reach structural foundations.
Annihilating eradication supplies the terminal context that flips equalization toward destructive leveling.
The repeated equality branch carries the same root operation into the aftermath of eradication.
Wide smooth ground supplies the concrete image of differences flattened into one level field.

structural_cues: سَوَّىٰ appears with the same surface, lemma, and root at 91:7[3] and 91:14[7].
The later occurrence closes a rapid fa-linked chain of denial, hamstringing, and annihilation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical recurrence plus disabling, eradication, equality, and smooth-ground branches; I supply backward semantic feedback from the later use to the focus. A live alternative preserves local polysemy: sound completion in 91:7 and only outcome-leveling in 91:14.

changed_reading.before: The self's taswiya is unambiguously benevolent perfecting.
changed_reading.after: The self's taswiya is constructive determination of order by a power whose equalizing operation can elsewhere become terminal leveling; completion and erasure remain disturbing co-potentials of the root.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following near the opening and aftermath at the close bracket the self with temporal extension. A deed has a tail, successors, traces, and an outcome that can be anticipated; taswiya can therefore include prospective orientation and retrospective continuity, making the self a trajectory rather than a momentary interior state.

activation_trace.role: Leeway, distance, length, and delay supply temporal extension within the focus root.
Discernment and hidden intent supply the capacity to project action toward a later result.
Turning toward a direction makes formed selfhood prospective rather than temporally inert.
Following and succession establish the earliest context image of ordered temporal consequence.
A thing's tail or ending supplies the trailing extension of an act conventionally named as guilt.
Fear as alarm at expected harm supplies prospective modeling of a not-yet-present result.
The rear of the foot and the trace it leaves supply embodied continuity behind movement.
Succession and one thing coming after another supply causal follow-through.
The end and outcome of a thing supply the terminal state toward which intention can be oriented.
A remnant and lingering trace supply persistence of action after the acting moment.

structural_cues: The context begins with one luminary following another and closes with fear and aftermath.
Between them, ذنب and عقب place moral action inside a chain of tails, traces, succession, and result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, a tail or ending, anticipated harm, succession, outcome, and residue; I infer that focus taswiya furnishes a temporally extended, consequence-modeling self. A live alternative is that the temporal frame belongs to the surrounding narrative and does not describe the constitution of النفس.

changed_reading.before: The proportioned self is a present-tense arrangement of faculties.
changed_reading.after: The proportioned self is a time-spanning trajectory able to aim ahead, leave traces behind, and become answerable to what follows.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the non-dominant س م م mapping under the 91:5 س م و cue and turns narrow apertures into a membrane analogy. It remains anchored through the focus branches of breath, hidden interior, and sound completion. Downstream prose should call it a cross-root material activation, not a lexical paraphrase of سَوَّىٰهَا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus self breathes and possesses a hidden interior, while taswiya can make that interior sound; the mapped aperture images suggest regulated exchange across its boundary.

activation_trace.role: Breath leaving the body requires a traversable boundary and supplies literal exchange.
The hidden inward mind supplies an interior that is not identical with its boundary.
Internal soundness supplies regulated integrity despite exchange with what is outside.
A narrow aperture through which something enters supplies the selective interface.
A special property lodged in the interior supplies differentiation between inward constitution and external passage.
Repair entering between disparate things supplies regulation at a boundary where differences meet.

changed_reading.before: The self is a closed interior made coherent.
changed_reading.after: The self may be carried as a selectively permeable interior whose soundness depends on regulating what passes through its openings.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare gambling-arrow branch of ن ف س together with the moon-root's wagering branch. It remains anchored by the focus noun and the measuring/equating branch of س و ي, then gains an outcome axis from success and failure. Downstream prose should present it only as imagery of agency under risk, never as a claim that the ayah literally describes gambling or chance creation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rare ن ف س arrow image and س و ي equivalence allow the proportioned self to appear as a measured stake placed into a consequential field.

activation_trace.role: The named fifth gambling arrow supplies the odd but focus-internal image of an allotted stake.
Equality and matching supply measurement among stakes or outcomes.
Wagering and overcoming through deception activate a field of risk and contest around the rare focus branch.
Success and enduring survival supply one consequential outcome.
Failure to attain the sought result supplies the opposing outcome.
A qidḥ that fails to kindle supplies a concrete image of latent potential that does not produce its hoped-for result.

changed_reading.before: The self receives a fixed completed constitution.
changed_reading.after: The self can be imagined as a measured endowment entering real risk, where formed capacities do not abolish divergent success and failure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because the visible-mark trigger comes from the non-dominant و س م mapping of the sky root and combines with a deceptive garment. It remains anchored in the focus contrast between hidden intent and internal soundness. Downstream prose should qualify it as a semiotic analogy: formed selves bear signs, but the ayah does not directly assert a theory of outward appearance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus distinguishes hidden inward intention from the operation that makes the self sound, allowing a question about how that interior becomes externally legible.

activation_trace.role: Hidden thought and intent supply an interior whose outward signs may reveal or misrepresent it.
Internal soundness supplies the condition against which faithful or deceptive appearance can be judged.
A visible mark by which something becomes known supplies an outward legibility interface.
A sign from which an observer infers condition supplies interpretation of surface evidence.
The lying self supplies inward distortion of the signal.
A garment that lies through its appearance supplies outward spoofing of the sign.
A thing's saying as its signification supplies the interpretive bridge from visible mark to claimed inner state.

changed_reading.before: The self's soundness is wholly internal.
changed_reading.after: The formed self may carry outward signs of inward condition, yet its signifying surface can be obscured or deliberately spoofed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the focus inventory's birth-to-maturity arc to distant branches of infertility, last-without-successor, roots, and offspring. It remains anchored in ن ف س birth and س و ي maturity, and the destructive sequel supplies a precise severance mechanism. Downstream prose should call it a lineage-scale extension of individual formation, not make النفس itself mean lineage.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Birth within ن ف س and maturity within س و ي let the completed self be read as a generative link rather than an isolated endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Birth and the newborn supply entry into generational continuity.
Full maturity supplies the capacity-bearing stage between birth and possible continuation.
Infertility and interruption of offspring supply direct severance of generative continuity.
A final thing with nothing following it supplies terminality without successor.
The root or base of a thing supplies the structural point at which continuity can be cut.
Offspring or descendants supply the continuation that destructive barrenness removes.
Succession supplies the broader temporal chain in which a mature self can function as one link.

changed_reading.before: Taswiya completes one individual life between birth and maturity.
changed_reading.after: Taswiya may also fit a life to become one generative link in succession, making the later cutting of root, mobility, and offspring a destruction of continuity itself.

strongest_changes: Static inward balance became cyclical regulation across disclosure and concealment.
The immediate breach-protection pair recast taswiya as formation of a bounded, permeable moral threshold.
Earth, ploughing, growth, and purification changed the finished self into prepared cultivable ground.
The exact 91:14 recurrence of سَوَّىٰ made constructive completion coexist with destructive leveling.
Following, tails, fear, traces, and aftermath extended the self from a present arrangement into a consequence-bearing trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories produced unusually exact cross-links with the context: wide smooth ground met earth-spreading and ploughing; breath and drink met watering; a camel-back support met the she-camel; hidden intent met inner speech and deceptive appearance. Most decisive was the same سَوَّىٰ returning after eradication, which prevented a safely one-valenced reading. Non-dominant mapped roots also opened live but contained models of selective permeability and outward marking.
remaining_uncertainties: The mā in وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا remains open between agent, act, and pattern even after later divine-agent cues.
The architectural, hydraulic, agricultural, and carrier models are abductive transfers from packet images, not direct lexical substitutions.
Repeated feminine pronouns create formal resonance but do not by themselves establish one referent across the context.
The non-dominant س م م, و س م, and س و ق mappings are valid activation material but remain substantially more form-distant than dominant-root readings.
Constructive completion and destructive leveling may be a deliberate shared operation or merely local polysemy; both readings remain live.
